package.title: Autonomyの後ろからControl Layerが追う — Safety・Scheming・Prompt Injection
package.editorial_angle: OpenAI–Anthropic joint evaluationをanchorに、scheming研究、gpt-oss-safeguard、Atlas/OWLのprompt-injection hardeningを結び、agent/action surfaceの拡大がsafety evaluationとcontrol engineeringを別レイヤとして要求したことを示す。
must_cover: joint safety evaluationを独立第三者benchmarkと誤認しない
scheming結果をcontrolled evaluationの範囲で扱う
gpt-oss-safeguardをopen-weight modelそのものと同一視しない
Atlas/OWL hardeningをprompt injection一般解決と表現しない
autonomy拡大とcontrol requirementを同一のcross-layer storyとして扱う
boundaries: Primary-source verification establishes the bounded facts recorded here; it does not convert vendor, project, or author evaluations into independent reproduction.
Findings come from controlled evaluations and should not be generalized to deployed-model behavior without the stated experimental scope.
